reviews_5s: Used this stainer many times. It is great if you have something large to strain. It's very sturdy and appears to be well made. Just use a small one if you have something small to strain.We use these in our restaurant. These strainers hold up fine under 10 hours of daily steady use. Fit perfectly in 10 inch boiler and can hold a couple pounds of veggies. I order a couple every year, they don't wear out, just eventually get too stained from the gas stove. Sturdy product good value.This is better quality than what I have in my home now. I didn’t expect that. My hubby was impressed! HIGHLY RECOMMENDStrong durable, love my strainerI have owned an identical strainer for more than 30 years. Finally started to fray around one side. Can’t complain about its durability.This drainer was a little small for what I wanted to use it for.This is a wonderful product! Has been working and very sturdy. Using it for about a month now and am very happy! Would definitely buy again but the way this is built, I think it will be a very long time!This strainer was just what I was looking for to strain my checked stock after I simmer it. It’s large enough to but over a stock pot.Does it job but did not expect it to be so bigThis is a strainer large enough to put over a waterbath canner (we process a lot of apple juice and needed a bigger strainer). It is solidly constructed. The handle and the "hanging hook" are not soldered, they are integrated within the rim, reducing the problem of the solder points coming apart as with other strainers. We bought the ExcelSteel Heavy Gauge Mesh Colander With Santopreme Handles, 11-1/4-Inch and the solder points came apart in shipping. We also purchased the ChefLand Stainless Steel Strainer with Support Handle (10-Inch) and it's mesh basket is flimsy and also has solder points. This Winco strainer product is solid and the double mesh layer is great!
